goals: Verify that Point objects correctly support arithmetic operations including addition, multiplication, subtraction, and division.
activities: Add three numeric Point objects together and assign the result to the Point object
Add three string Point objects together and assign the result to the Point object
Multiply three numeric Point objects together and assign the result to the Point object
Subtract a Point object from another Point object and assign the result to the Point object
Divide a Point object by another Point object and assign the result to the Point object
